title: Shall We Run?
author: Krishna Anand, XI C, 07/29/2025
content:
I ran forever believing to be conscious to some extent
Once I realized, I was just being sentient!

Each cell of my body was tied to a very visible string,
It was just me who was blind enough to unsee
Each thread was being controlled by someone from the audience
Neither I knew them, nor they recognized me.

The race was just too long for me to complete by now
I wasn’t even halfway through when I realized
That something’s quite inexplicable
Not exquisite but unfathomable.

I noticed that the audience was classified by age
The experienced ones had their experience outdated 
But still were holding most of the threads for coverage
The next gen was eager enough to learn but
Innocent enough to copy their wicked elders.

Amidst the thread holders there was a third group
They were of my generation
Not part of the race, it astounded me
They were not holding any thread, but were promoting the scissors
No runner ever listened to them, perhaps out of the regret of their wasted shoes.

I realized something
I was not at all conscious, I was barely even sentient
The race was not everything, something was parallel to it, perhaps better
Perhaps it was not for everybody, perhaps it was bitter.

At the end of the day all I could remember was that the hardest choices require the strongest wills!

title: Dread Training
author: Krishna Anand, 8 Aug, 2025
content:
As started a decade ago
It was the manipulating phase.

Our conscience was not conscious
The so-called philanthropy
It was not whole but part preposterous.

Then time passed
We were locked down
Media was not real
Our training was a complement of the surreal.

When skies cleared we were chained
The lock was open but we were in vain.

Our camp left us on our own
We never questioned but our spirit was gone.

Now the camp was afraid
We weren’t astounded
The camp was afraid for itself
And we were still wounded.

Then came the dread training
It was quite chrono-draining
They were already in ruins, yet boasted lies
The camp made us dunce, and we were dead-alive.

title: आज़ादी ये झूठी है
author: कृष्ण आनंद, XI ‘C’, 11/08/2025
content:
15 अगस्त आया है मित्रों, पर आज़ादीs ये झूठी है।
परीक्षा की आज़ादी नहीं, परिणाम में देरी और त्रुटि है।

झूठे धर्म का मुद्दा दिया, ज्ञान झूठा विज्ञान असत्य, असभ्य मनोरंजन की स्तुति है
15 अगस्त आया है मित्रों, पर आज़ादी ये झूठी है।

विश्वगुरु तो सदियों से है, स्वगुरु भी ज़रूरी है,
स्त्री पुरुष भरे हुए हैं, उनकी कद्र ज़रूरी है,
ज्ञान विज्ञान मोह माया है, उसके प्रति आदर ज़रूरी है,
काम तो जैसे धन राशि, उसके लिए प्रेम ज़रूरी है,
15 अगस्त आया है मित्रों, पर आज़ादी भी ज़रूरी है।

खुल के न वो बोल सके, एक दूजे से न मिल सके,
धन्य हो समाज ऐसा, जो निस्वार्थ रिश्ते भी चीर सके।

संस्थान को अपना स्वार्थ है, कर्मचारी की मति मारी है,
कर्म तो जैसे भोग कुंजी, राष्ट्र का पाप भारी है।

उन किसानों का सोचो, जो वर्षा बिन मर जायेंगे,
उन ठेले वालों का क्या कसूर जो भीषण गर्मी से तप जायेंगे,
क्या जुर्म उन कर्मचारियों का, जो परमाणु के खतरे में है,
उनकी आज़ादी कब होगी जो सरहद पर रोज़ मरते है।

आज़ादी है क्रांति की, मन से बस हम बंधे हैं,
चिंगारी अब बुझ जाएगी, यहां जलती रूह भी सूखी है,
15 अगस्त आया है मित्रों, आज़ादी ये झूठी है।

title: युद्ध से पहले की आहुति
author: कृष्णा आनंद, 26/08/2025
content:
युद्ध से पहले की आहुति पूर्णविराम से चढ़ाओगे।

अंततः तुम मृत्यु को ही प्राप्त हो कर जाओगे!

अंत काल वो आयेगा, मौत का परचम लाएगा 

कलयुग का फिर अंत होगा सत्य राज जो आयेगा!

युद्ध...

मां के अश्रु सुख गए हैं, सुख गया है उनका तन। 

दिल से लेकर कोशिका तक निचोड़ लिया ना भरा है मन। 

पुष्क फट रहे, रक्त सूख रहा, खत्म हो रहा मां का क्षम। 

एक दिन वो अब आयेगा, रौद्र तांडव लाएगा, विष से तू घिर जाएगा, अश्रु सैलाब लाएगा।

title: टाइम है एक्साम्स का [हिंदी]
author: कृष्णा आनंद, IX A
content:
टाइम है एक्साम्स का
फिजिक्स केमिस्ट्री मैथ्स का
आज जंग की घड़ी की तुम गुहार दो

हिस्ट्री सिविक्स जियोग्राफी हो या
इंग्लिश की वो फिलोसोफ़ी
आज एक आंसर शीट पे उतार दो

टाइम है एक्साम्स का

मन करे सो टॉप करे
जो मन करे सो फ़ल करे
वोही तो एक सर्वशक्तिमान है

मार्क्स की पुकार है ये एक्साम्स का सार है 
की रटना ही तो वीर का प्रमाण है

यु.पि.एस.सी. की भीड़ हो या
बोर्ड्स का नीड़ हो
जो रट सका है वोही तो महान है

टाइम है एक्साम्स का

रैंक की हवास नहीं 
रटने पे कोई वश नहीं 
क्या अंडरस्टैंडिंग है की ठोकरों पे मार दो 
नंबरों के अंत नहीं तो नंबरों से क्यूँ डरें
ये जाके शीट पे उतार दो

टाइम है एक्साम्स का 

वो कॉन्सेप्ट्स का भाव याकि रटने का चुनाव याकि हार का वो घाव तुम ये सोच लो x2
सीखने का मन हो या फिर रटने का धन हो जाके तुम ये पहले सोच लो

जिस ज्ञान की कल्पना में जिंदगी हो कॉन्सेप्ट्स की, उस ज्ञान को आज तुम नकार दो
दुखती नसों से आज ठंढी रघों से आज ख़ुशी के डी.एन.ए. को तुम उखाड़ दो

टाइम है एक्साम्स का

title: Time Hai Exams Ka [Hinglish]
author: Krishna Anand, IX A
content:
Time ha exams ka
Physics, Chemistry, Maths ka
Aaj jung ki ghadi ki tum guhar do

History, Civics, Geography ho ya
English ki wo philosophy
Aaj ek answer sheet pe utaar do

Time hai exams ka

Man kare so top kare
Jo man kare so fail kare
Vohi to ek sarvshaktimaan hai

Marks ki pukaar hai ye exams ka saar hai
Ki ratna hi to veer ka praman hai

UPSC ki bheed ho ya
BOARDS ka need ho
Jo rat saka hai vohi to mahan hai

Time hai exams ka

Rank ki hawas nahi
Ratne pe koi vash nahi
Kya understanding hai ki thokaron pe maar do
Numberon ke ant nahin to numberon se kyun daren
Ye jaake sheet pe utaar do

Time hai exams ka

Jo concepts ka bhaav yaki ratne ka chunav yaki fail ka vo ghaav tum ye soch lo x2
Seekhne ka man ho ya fir ratne ka dhan ho jaake tum ye pahle soch lo

Jis gyaan ki kalpana me zindgi ho concepts ki, us gyaan ko aaj tum nakar do
Dukhti nason se aaj dhandhi raghon se aaj khushi ke DNA ko tum ukhaad do

Time hai exams ka

title: 9th Grade Physics
author: Krishna Anand, IX A
content:
The first equation arrives
Your final speed derives

Start with your speed
It shouldn't be the end
Sum the acceleration, and grow a second.

Now we want the shortest path! Start with your speed
Amplify some "time" with your deed
Square the seconds
Add them to the amplified
But by fifty percent.

Let's check the third Like a physics nerd.
Twice the acceleration times the distance.
Equals the subtraction of velocities' persistence.
Square them and minus, to get the result Your Highness!

The graphs we study are s.t. v.t. a.t.
And they can do the derivation
Plotting motion line by line
Making easy "the calculation".

A push or a pull Is called a force
Which originates from a source.
To know your might
See your bulkiness
And the acceleration tight.

The laws of motion
Given by Newton,
Have inertia, momentum and some action
As for every action there's an equal and opposite reaction!

Now we know the action
Let's meet the gravitation.
Check the 7th alphabet
Capital defines a constant,
Small varies, accelerating
It differs at different positioning.

Newton's 4th law, Gravitation
Kepler's three laws, Planetary motion,
Archimedes gave buoyancy
Which differs by density.

On a circular track, you won a race
You became a hero but the work done is zero!
Get the displacement and the force
You got the joule, whatever the source.

You are moving, whatever your strategy,
You possess something called kinetic energy!
Halve the mass, square the velocity
You got a formula, without a formality.

You have a height, you have a miracle,
The energy you possess is called potential!
Mass and height, gravity's might,
Multiply them and you got the formula right!

Sorry, it’s the power.
To get the equation, write work done over time
Now use it and climb a tower.
Here comes the final chapter
Sound is on its way
Longitudinal in nature
Just some wavelengths away.

Waves are transverse
Waves are longitudinal
First is light
Second is like audible.
First travels in vacuum too.
Second depends on a medium,
Solid Liquid Gas or Plasma
But doesn’t have a spectrum.

Waves of sound have some strength
They have some compressions and relaxations
Distance starting from compression is a wavelength
If it ends with rarefactions.

Your shrillness is your frequency
Your loudness is your amplitude
If pleasant, called music, otherwise noise
From now, Sound’s elements understood.

Do you know your sound’s speed?
Get your wavelength, indeed
Multiply by frequency
Are you happy? I see.
